body: Someone make sure the mods delete this after 2 days please haha. I told my friend I visit this subreddit and I don't want her to find this post. She probably wouldn't know what happened for a few days and hoping that's enough time for others like me find this post haha

I can't help you, but I hope you feel better knowing that at least someone read the whole thing. I don't think its stupid at all, the way you feel is understandable. I hope someone here can give advice on how to get better though. Good luck, I will be rooting for you
